display.purpose: Primary FPS / throughput metric in the KPI strip.

shadows.name: floating-tooltip

components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: High-contrast primary trigger for upgrades and mode toggles.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 4px; background: #ffffff; color: #000000; border: 1px solid #ffffff; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Secondary Control Button
components.description: Secondary toolbar button for 3D camera, explode, and simulation controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 4px; background: #111111; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #3d3d3d; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: #38bdf8; color: #38bdf8; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

narrative.overview: ThermBench 3D is an engineering telemetry bench where the exploded 3D silicon assembly and real-time thermal/pipeline instruments share a ruled dark-room workspace.
keyCharacteristics: Ruled T-frame data-terminal shell with 1px solid #262626 structural hairlines.
Technical grotesque (IBM Plex Sans) paired with tabular monospace (JetBrains Mono) for live telemetry counters.
Origin-aware 3D projected tooltips, physical press feedback (scale(0.97)), and interruptible clip-path hold-to-stress interactions.

rules.name: The Thermal Chromatic Priority Rule
rules.body: Chrome never competes with the heat map: saturated red, amber, and cyan are reserved for live temperature, throttling status, and active selection.

rules.name: The Tabular Telemetry Rule
rules.body: Every live-updating temperature, clock frequency, wattage, RPM, and FPS readout must apply font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums (.num).

dos: Do use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on every live numerical readout.
Do gate all :hover states behind @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) and provide :active { transform: scale(0.97) } press feedback.
Do animate only transform, opacity, and clip-path on UI elements under 300ms using --ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1).
donts: Don't use transition: all or ease-in on any UI control.
Don't import Three.js or DOM APIs inside /src/sim.
